title: feat(packages/excalidraw): support onDuplicate replacements, vetoes and lookups
body:
When `onDuplicate` returned new objects for duplicates, paste and library insertion still assigned frames and redrew bound text on the old objects, and Alt-drag continued dragging an object outside the scene. Merge returned changes into the editor's duplicates so subsequent processing uses the same objects and the changes stay in the duplication's undo entry and durable increment.

- Apply replacements consistently across the duplicate action, Alt-drag, paste, and library insertion. Preserve omitted properties and invalidate cached shapes and bounds after merging.
- Support vetoing individual duplicates by omission or `isDeleted`, and cancelling the whole duplication with `false`. Remove dependent bound text and clear references to vetoed duplicates. If all duplicates are vetoed, paste and the duplicate action do nothing; Alt-drag moves the originals. With a partial Alt-drag veto, the vetoed originals stay behind.
- Resolve destination frame membership and ordering before calling `onDuplicate` on paste or library insertion.
- Add a third callback argument with read-only maps: `duplicateElements`, `originalElements`, `origIdToDuplicateId`, and `duplicateIdToOrigId`, for identifying copies and remapping host-owned references.

Validation: 48 focused tests pass across `onDuplicate.test.tsx` and `duplicate.test.tsx`; typecheck and ESLint on all changed TypeScript files pass. Regression coverage includes replacement objects, partial and total vetoes, callback lookup maps, stale shape/bounds caches, and partial labels whose containers are vetoed.
